wa_template:
Hi, {inviter} invites you to join their family "{family}" in *Legado Vivo*, the family archive where we keep photos, audios and stories.

1. Open this link: {appUrl}
2. Create your account (or sign in if you already have one).
3. Choose “Join with a code” and enter this code: *{code}*

You will join as {role}. The code expires on {expires}. See you there!
